id: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Skill Swap.
en: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Skill Swap.
it: \bDopo aver passato anni in questa città ho deciso di rendermi utile insegnando la mossa Baratto.

id: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
en: \bI can teach it to you if you want?

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bI lost to May? How did I lose to someone like her?
en: \bI lost to May? How did I lose to someone like her?
it: \bHo perso contro Vera? Come ho fatto a perdere contro una come lei?

id: \bWait, you know her? Perfect. You can show me a new way to win.
en: \bWait, you know her? Perfect. You can show me a new way to win.
it: \bAspetta, la conosci? Perfetto. Puoi mostrarmi un nuovo modo per vincere.

id: \bThis isn't over. I'll be the best Coordinator!
en: \bThis isn't over. I'll be the best Coordinator!
it: \bNon finisce qui. Diventerò il miglior Coordinatore!

id: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
en: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
it: \rMi dispiace molto, ma il termine per le iscrizioni è scaduto.

id: \rMy Charmander got too nervous to compete so I had to drop out. It's no big deal.
en: \rMy Charmander got too nervous to compete so I had to drop out. It's no big deal.
it: \rIl mio Charmander era troppo nervoso per gareggiare, quindi mi sono dovuta ritirare. Non è niente di grave.
